Listing and layout disclosure: This listing copy and layout were created with AI-assisted work and finalized for print by our production partner GreenLine Printworks. The printed phrase and eyebrow/footer text are presented exactly as produced (no changes to the approved wording).
rationale: Treatment: chosen a sports-scoreboard style (style: scoreboard, palette: green) to match the brief for a loud, direct punishment flag in a dark green scoreboard treatment.
